name: Managed Environments
short_description: A suite of premium Power Platform capabilities that lets admins govern environments at scale, for example with usage insights, sharing limits and solution checking.

evidence.quote: Only managed environments can join a group.
Managed environment controls like conditional access and data loss prevention became the mandatory baseline
Data Verse lives inside managed environments, development, test, production
A governed environment with clear boundaries, managed environments and DLP rules enables more delivery rather than less.
A managed environment is a standard environment with extra controls switched on
